description: Records a stop caused by an API rate limit, so the pause is visible rather than looking like a finished turn.

hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.sh" node-notice /rate-limit-guard:check RATE_LIMIT_GUARD_ENABLED; ${PPID:+exit}; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.ps1" node-notice /rate-limit-guard:check RATE_LIMIT_GUARD_ENABLED
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that node is on PATH...
